newsitem.title: USA: FERC rejects Portland Genl Electric retail pilot.
newsitem.headline: FERC rejects Portland Genl Electric retail pilot.

text.p: The Federal Energy Regulatory Commission (FERC) has said Portland General Electric Co's plan for a retail wheeling pilot in Oregon does not meet rules for open access transmission.
The federal agency recently issued a similar ruling on a retail wheeling pilot now underway with Washington Water Power Co's large industrial customers.
FERC said the programmes do not meet terms of the agency's Order 888, which requires that retail wheeling pilots be implemented under wholesale tariffs.
A spokeswoman for Portland General said FERC suggested two ways of resolving the matter, including having the Oregon Public Utility Commission ask FERC approval of the plan.
In addition, Portland General could alter its pro-forma wholesale wheeling tariff to be consistent with the retail open access pilot, she said.
For now, the utility's pilot programme is on hold, but Portland General expects to launch it in April or May.
